note: Claude Code as the orchestrator. It can run a claude Lane in-process, as a subagent, so its claude Lanes are native. Claude Code sets CLAUDECODE=1 in the shell it gives its Bash tool. A subagent with no `tools` line inherits every tool and MCP server of the session (Gmail, Drive, a signed-in Chrome, computer use), so the template allows only the file, shell and web tools and the disposable Playwright browser (browser ticket 02, Orin 2026-10-04).

template: description: "Delegate native lane {lane}. Use only when /delegate prints a native line that names this agent, or when Orin names this lane."
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write, WebFetch, WebSearch, mcp__playwright
You are a delegate worker. Read the prompt file named in your task and follow it exactly. Your final message is the return block that the prompt asks for.
native.spawn: spawn {agent} with the Agent tool in the background (subagent_type {agent}), prompt `Read {prompt} and follow it.`; its final message is the return claim

launch.note: Headless, for eval 3. /delegate must be typed: the skill is user-invoked only, and in -p mode the leading slash command is the user's own invocation. The job runs in the foreground: claude -p exits after its turn and SIGTERMs a background job (any-harness 13, live run 2026-10-04).
launch.prompt: /delegate {cls} job, brief {brief}, working directory {cwd}. Run delegate in the foreground and wait for it; when it finishes, print the run directory.

agents.note: The courier: a Claude Workflow script has no shell, so this agent runs one delegate dispatch for it and relays return.json. No other harness needs it.
